verdict.rationale: Rainforest is a hosted payments-facilitation service. Self-hosting is a fair question for payment platforms, since open-source and self-hostable payment stacks exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Rainforest's core can be deployed on your own infrastructure. The on-premises webhook guide covers the customer's own software running in a private network, and data-export ownership is not self-hosting, so neither counts.
